# `lib/test.x`

Registered tests and assertions for user programs.

## Primary API

| Function | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`Test.check`](#Test.check) | Records a failed condition with its source text and location. |
| [`Test.compare`](#Test.compare) | Compares boxed values and records their representations on failure. |
| [`Test.main`](#Test.main) | Runs registered tests, returning 1 on failure or 2 for an unmatched filter. |
| [`Test.register`](#Test.register) | Registers a function, its name, and the location of its decoration. |
| [`Test.skip`](#Test.skip) | Marks the running test skipped and stops its body. |

### `Test`

<a id="Test.check"></a>
#### Test.check

`void Test.check(int condition, String expression, String file, int line)`

Records a failed condition with its source text and location.

Source: `lib/test.x`

<a id="Test.compare"></a>
#### Test.compare

`void Test.compare(Var actual, Var expected, String file, int line)`

Compares boxed values and records their representations on failure.
Two differing multiline Strings also produce a unified difference.

Source: `lib/test.x`

<a id="Test.main"></a>
#### Test.main

`int Test.main(int argc, char **argv)`

Runs registered tests, returning 1 on failure or 2 for an unmatched
filter. `--filter TEXT` is repeatable and selects names containing any
filter; `--list` prints selected names; `--quiet` omits passing lines.

Source: `lib/test.x`

<a id="Test.register"></a>
#### Test.register

`void Test.register( const char *name, TestFunction function, const char *file, int line)`

Registers a function, its name, and the location of its decoration.
`$test` calls this before main, preserving declaration order.

Source: `lib/test.x`

<a id="Test.skip"></a>
#### Test.skip

`void Test.skip(String reason)`

Marks the running test skipped and stops its body.

Source: `lib/test.x`
